assertions.text: Output is a valid YAML document
At least one task explicitly sets parameters.set_outputs: true to emit a value for downstream use
A downstream reference uses the ORCHESTRA.PIPELINE_RUN_TASKS[...].OUTPUTS[...] templating syntax rather than a bare Python variable name or in-process object

No Dagster IOManager class, io_manager decorator, or IO-manager-key wiring is carried over into the Orchestra YAML or its referenced scripts — persistence becomes an explicit write/read inside the task's own script instead

Any large or complex data (DataFrames, file contents, query result sets) is staged externally (e.g. S3, a warehouse table) with only a small reference — a path, table name, id, or count — passed as the output value, never the full object embedded inline in the YAML
